entries.partTitle: HDR Render Graph Architecture & Transient Resource Aliasing

spec.title: System Architecture: HDR Render Graph Architecture & Transient Resource Aliasing

steps.caption: Architectural overview displays the complete post-processing render graph resolving multi-stage pass dependencies.

Verification confirms topological sorting order, zero race hazards, and optimal command buffer encoding.

steps.caption: Architectural overview illustrates the photographic ACES filmic S-curve transforming high dynamic range light into display signals.
